I fixed the bug in `anthrouter/pace.py`. For UTC, September 2026 now counts 22 workdays instead of 23. I ran only `tests/test_pace.py`, and its 30 tests pass. The full suite was still running when I stopped, so it isn't confirmed.

`period_workday_dates` treated the end of the period as inclusive. In UTC the period ends at `2026-10-01 00:00`, so Oct 1 (a Thursday) was counted as a September workday. The function now drops the end date when the period end falls exactly at local midnight. For timezones behind UTC, such as `America/Los_Angeles`, the end falls on Sep 30 evening, so Sep 30 is still counted as before.

I didn't add a regression test, since you said to change source code only. The full suite is still running in the background as task `beqg3igna`.
